Here is the world famous Fumee Falls. One of the few waterfalls in Michigan that eventually flows into Lake Michigan. This is a small waterfall, but it is right along the road side and very easy to visit along the north side of US 2 about 6 miles east of Iron Mountain, Michigan. #chasingwaterfalls

Waterfall of the night: Superior Falls, on the Montreal River bordering Wisconsin and Michigan. The falls tumble into a cove, and the river completes its short journey to Lake Superior. On the Michigan side you’re as far west in the state as you can get — about as far west as St Louis, Missouri.

Copper Falls State Park, where the Bad and Tyler Forks rivers meet near Mellen, Wisc., is gorgeous. Also, very concerned with flooding. A 1941 flood wiped out a bridge over the Bad River; it wasn’t replaced until 1981. The bridge survived a 2016 flood that killed 3. www.weather.gov/dlh/flash-fl...

Northshore Adventure Day 1 - Cascade River that pours into Lake Superior and a few of the waterfalls there. There are many trails and waterfalls along this river. I keep typing Northsore - which is more accurate because of all the hiking.

One of my favorite places anywhere is the Temperance River just south of Tofte, MN, which spills out into a deep section of Lake Superior (it's called Temperance River because there's no sand bar). It's easy to let the falls totally drown out the rest of the world. I love that lake so much.

Copper Falls in northern Wisconsin. It's regionally well known, but I don't think many people realize how many waterfalls there are along the rivers that drain northward into Lake Superior. You could spend a whole summer on them. #waterfalls #wisconsin #CopperFallsStatePark #ProtectPublicLands
2 are from Lake Superior, pebble beach is one location but I don’t recall the other. The waterfall is from one of the many mini hikes we stopped on our drive along the lake.

The Tobacco River in the Keweenaw empties into Lake Superior via a set of gentle stairstep waterfalls, just north of Gay, MI. It’s surrounded by a small park that is one of the most peaceful places I have ever been lucky enough to visit. Listening to the babbling stream meeting gentle waves.
